mintAuthority.summary: The sole authored USDB deployment is Blast's bridge representation. The Ethereum USDYieldManager/L1BlastBridge route anchors reserve and bridge accounting, but no independently authored native-USDB issuance deployment is claimed; bridge mint/burn and upgrade controls are reviewed only in Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: At Blast block 39052431 (2026-08-16), the authored USDB deployment 0x4300000000000000000000000000000000000003 resolved to a bridge-only mint/burn path through L2BlastBridge 0x4300000000000000000000000000000000000005, and the official USDB source restricts mint and burn to that bridge. At Ethereum block 25770239 (2026-08-16), L1BlastBridge and USDYieldManager reads establish the paired deposit, conversion, and withdrawal route; USDYieldManager totalValue() and sharePrice() describe route-level reserve accounting, not a native USDB issuance cap. The former bridge-admin and proxy-admin facts are preserved in bridgeRouteRisk and are not counted as native Mint Authority. Queue convergence review 2026-10-03 re-read USDB.sol at pinned source commit b82105486bfe33c8b12986e7cd42388fbab7d1d2: mint(address,uint256) and burn(address,uint256) both require onlyBridge, which rejects callers other than immutable BRIDGE. With the reviewed external-only-representation exception covering the sole authored deployment and no authored native mint control, adaptMintReview emits a known not-applicable mint review with null controlKey and no mint controls; the published posture is none-resolved. Annotate none-resolved-mint for that native-mint scope only. The unresolved distinct-native-liability question, mintPath unknown, confidence unknown, and adverse Bridge Risk controls are retained; this source re-read does not claim a new live implementation pin or absence of bridge upgrade powers.
unresolvedQuestions: No separate canonical Ethereum USDB contract is authored; if a distinct native-liability deployment exists outside the reviewed Blast route, it remains to be identified.

noLocalIssuance.rationale: The only authored contract is the Blast USDB bridge representation; official Blast documentation and verified source tie mint/burn to L2BlastBridge and the Ethereum route, so no independently authored local native-USDB issuance is claimed.
